summary: Oral partition vs settlement deed; family arrangement defence rejected; concurrent findings on oral partition binding; nomenclature vs substance of deed as settlement not gift; love and affection valid consideration; settlement deed upholding 2/3rd share upheld; High Court error in recharacterising deed; exclusive possession under separate pattas insufficient for oral partition; preliminary decree modified.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court and First Appellate Court decrees restored; 2/3rd share confirmed in favour of respondents.
